summary: Backend-only testing of Phase 4 features (Categories/Breaking/Sidebar/Layouts CRUD + article category validation + backward-compat). Wrote 27 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/backend_test_phase4.py; all 27 PASS against local backend http://localhost:8001 (public preview /api returns 404 due to Kubernetes ingress issue, as noted by main agent).

minor.issue: slugify() falls back to a random UUID when the input contains no word chars (e.g. slug='!!!'), so an 'invalid slug' never returns 400 — the endpoint silently creates a category with a random slug. The `if not slug` guard at server.py:1052 is unreachable. Consider validating the input slug format (e.g. regex ^[a-z0-9-]+$) BEFORE slugifying, or return 400 when the sanitized slug differs from the input.

The right-side auto-topup uses `skip_offset = remaining` which is `limit - len(curated)`. When there are curated items this skips a variable, non-obvious number of latest articles, and can accidentally repeat/miss items. Consider a deterministic bias like skip=limit or a set-difference over full latest list.

action_items: Optional: harden slug validation in POST /api/categories so purely-symbolic slugs return 400 instead of being coerced to a random uuid.
Optional: revisit right-sidebar auto-topup skip logic to avoid duplicate/skip surprises when curated items exist.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1328 lines — recommend splitting into modules (auth, articles, categories, breaking, sidebar, layouts, newsletter) for maintainability.

get_current_admin returns 401 (not 403) for logged-in non-admin users because get_current_user throws 401 for anon; non-admin path in get_current_admin (line 119) does return 403. Verified both branches: reader→403, anon→401. OK.
CategoryUpdate lets order be updated but not slug; that is intentional and safe (slug is referenced by articles).
Layouts endpoint doesn't validate block shape (List[Any]); any JSON is accepted. Acceptable for MVP but consider a stricter schema (i,x,y,w,h,type) to guard the FE.
Sidebar list returns non-active curated items excluded (good), but PUT accepts `active` flip; ensure FE curator surfaces inactive items via /api/admin/sidebar-news.
